art_direction: 午夜电光：27岁成年原创女性，黑高马尾与电蓝挑染，黑白骑行夹克和深色长裤，双手放在膝前侧坐停稳机车休息；电青洋红霓虹与雨后倒影构成夜景。

wallpaper.visual_review_notes: Inspected compressed 589x1280 canonical preview. One adult woman with refined anime face, black ponytail and cyan highlights. Two coherent sleeved arms rest over the same knee; near hand is visible and the farther hand extends partly beyond the right crop. Opaque black-white jacket and dark trousers, seated on stationary motorcycle. Vivid cyan and magenta wet-street light, clear upper night sky. No extra limbs, text, watermark or other people.
